name.description: Defined-set name, not a neighbor IP address.

List.description: Entries for non-prefix defined sets. This write-time key is capitalized; GET uses lowercase list.

prefixList.description: Entries for prefix defined sets; use instead of List when defineset_type is prefix.

masklengthRange.description: Inclusive prefix-length range minimum..maximum. Numeric parse errors, uint32 narrowing, family bounds, and ordering are not fully validated locally.

items.description: Prefix-set entry with CIDR ipPrefix and inclusive minimum..maximum masklengthRange. Local parsing checks the separator but ignores numeric conversion errors and narrows to uint32; prefix-family limits and range ordering require explicit validation rather than reliance on this schema.
